# Copilot Instructions - Next.js Inventarios App

## Project Overview
- **Framework**: Next.js 15 with React 19
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS + Shadcn UI
- **Database**: Supabase
- **Deployment**: Vercel
- **Repository**: GitHub

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Follow ESLint rules
- Components in `components/` directory
- Pages in `app/` directory (App Router)
- Utilities in `lib/` directory
- Environment variables in `.env.local`

## Project Setup Checklist

- [x] Crear copilot-instructions.md
- [x] Verificar requisitos del proyecto
- [x] Scaffold del proyecto Next.js
- [x] Instalar extensiones necesarias
- [x] Compilar proyecto
- [x] Crear tareas de desarrollo
- [x] Lanzar servidor de desarrollo
- [x] Documentación completa
